newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen weak on lack of support.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen weak on lack of support.

text.p: Pakistan stocks are likely to remain weak on Monday on lack of support from institutions and investors, dealers said.

"The index is likely to open up on speculative buying of Hub Power and a few other blue chips, but would slip towards the close," dealer Sajjad Mankani said. "Investors and institutions are on the sidelines."
On Friday, the index rose 16.05 points, or 0.85 percent, to end at 1,914.32. Losers led gainers 149 to 62.
Turnover fell to 41.05 million shares from 60.09 million in the previous session.
